headline: Supplementary Budget of NT$607.6 Billion Sent to Legislature; DPP: Please Quickly Review and Support Oil and Electricity Price Freeze, KMT and TPP | ETtoday Politics
summary: Taiwan's central government sent a NT$607.6 billion supplementary budget to the Legislative Yuan. The DPP cited Middle East conflict-driven swings in oil and gas prices and seeks funding to stabilize oil, electricity and natural gas prices.
why: Taipower and CPC are Taiwan's state-owned electricity and oil companies, so their pricing and subsidies affect energy costs, inflation and public finances.
